si4_title: Structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behaviour in schizophrenia: Mega-analysis of data from 2095 patients and 2861 healthy controls via the ENIGMA consortium

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study is a mega-analysis pooling data from 20 sites participating in the ENIGMA-Schizophrenia Working Group. Specific datasets mentioned that map to the guidance list include COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence), MCIC (MIND Clinical Imaging Consortium), and UMCU (Utrecht Schizophrenia project).
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data came from the Schizophrenia Working Group of the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis (ENIGMA) consortium ... Twenty member sites contributed data to the current study.

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls (HC) from the 20 ENIGMA sites were used to derive/train the normative models for both grey matter and white matter phenotypes. Patients with schizophrenia (SZ) from the same sites were evaluated for individual deviations (z-scores) from these models to study associations with aggressive behaviour.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For every IDP, we derived a normative model in the healthy controls ... The normative models were then run in the patients to calculate how much they deviated (in z-scores) from healthy controls at the individual level.

dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.detail: The normative models for grey matter (GM) phenotypes (volume, thickness, surface area) were derived from 2718 healthy controls across 20 sites. The models for white matter (WM) phenotypes (microstructural integrity) were derived from 1461 healthy controls across 9 sites. There is no mention of a separate validation or test phase for healthy controls; the models were derived from the full HC pool and then applied to patients.

dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Healthy control age mean and SD were 35 and 13 for the T1-weighted cohort, and 34 and 14 for the diffusion-weighted cohort. Specific median, IQR, and range values for healthy controls were not explicitly reported for the pooled 'All' group.
dc4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: Table 1 ... All [HC] Age, M (SD) = 35 (13) ... Table 2 ... All [HC] Age, M (SD) = 34 (14)

dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: For the T1-weighted model (Model 1), there were 1333 males (49.0%) out of 2718 HC. For the diffusion-weighted model (Model 2), there were 649 males (44.4%) out of 1461 HC. Female counts and percentages were calculated from these values.
dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: Table 1 ... All [HC] Male, n (%) = 1333 (49) [Total n=2718] ... Table 2 ... All [HC] Male, n (%) = 649 (44) [Total n=1461]
dc5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.reason: Female N was calculated by subtracting the reported Male N from the reported Total N for the pooled healthy control sample in each modality table. Percentages were derived from the resulting N and the total sample size.
